title: Pork and Sauerkraut
description:
Did you know that eating pork on New Year's Day is said to bring you good fortune in the upcoming year? It's true! Country Style Ribs with Sauerkraut is the perfect dish to ring in the New Year with!
This country style ribs recipe is a delicious way to ensure that good fortune finds you this year! Country style pork ribs are seasoned, seared, and then slow baked with sauerkraut and apples until they are fork tender for a delicious pork dinner for not only on New Year's Day, but any day of the year.
ingredients: 1 package (14 ounces or so) sauerkraut, drained (or not, depending on your taste for sourness)
1 cup broth (chicken or beef or apple cider)
2 apples cut up into bite-sized chunks
directions: In a Dutch oven, cook ribs and onion in oil until ribs are browned and onion is tender.
Remove from the heat. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over ribs. (If you want the apples to retain some shape, you could cut them bigger and wait a half hour or so to add them to the pan.)
Cover and bake at 350° until ribs are tender, 1-1/2 to 2 hours.
